title: Settings
description: Limits, look and language. Changes save on this computer.

account.title: Account & limits
account.subtitle: Written to the skills' config. Every ticket is sized and risk-checked against these.
account.loadFailed: Couldn't load your current settings. Showing defaults.

hints.accountSize: The cash you trade with, in USD. Position sizes and limits are worked out from it.
hints.maxLossPerTrade: The most you're willing to lose on one trade if the stop loss is hit. The number of shares is worked out from this: risk ÷ distance to the stop.
hints.maxDailyLoss: Your stop for the day. New entries are blocked once today's losses plus the risk of open trades would go over this amount.
hints.maxTradesPerDay: New entries are blocked after this many trades today, so one bad morning can't turn into ten trades.
hints.minRewardRisk: How far the target is compared with the stop. 1.5 means the possible gain is at least 1.5× the possible loss; tickets below it are blocked.
hints.cashBuffer: Share of the account that is never used for positions, kept aside as a cushion.
hints.pdtGuard: US rule for margin accounts under $25,000: 4 or more day trades within 5 business days marks you as a pattern day trader and can restrict the account. The guard warns before the trade that would cross that line.
hints.maxPositionPct: The most of your account one position may use, even when the stop is tight.
hints.maxOrderUsd: Upper limit for the dollar value of a single order.
hints.requireStop: Blocks any ticket without a stop loss. Strongly recommended for day trading.
hints.noEntriesBefore: Skips the noisy first minutes after the 09:30 open.
hints.noEntriesAfter: No new trades after this time, so there is room to manage them before the close.
hints.flatBy: Every day trade should be closed by this time. Flat-by alerts use it.

window.title: Entry window (New York time)
window.hint: Entries are only allowed inside the window. Every open trade should be closed by the flat-by time.

errors.aboveDaily: Can't be higher than the daily loss limit
errors.aboveAccount: Can't be higher than the account size
errors.integer: Enter a whole number, 1 or more
errors.window: Must be later than the previous time

data.title: Data & SEC
data.description: Data sources, delay and your SEC EDGAR identity.

sec.title: SEC EDGAR identity
sec.subtitle: Used by the news monitor (8-K filings) and the earnings analyst.
sec.hint: Your name or company followed by a contact email.
sec.whyTitle: Why does the SEC ask for this?
sec.why: SEC EDGAR is free, but its fair-access rules require every automated request to say who is asking, with a contact email, so they can reach you if something goes wrong. Requests without it can be blocked.
sec.privacy: It is only sent to sec.gov, in the request header. Leave it empty and SEC features stay off.

errors.email: Include a contact email, e.g. Jane Doe jane@example.com

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.on: On: using the bundled TSLA example
demo.explain: Demo mode is chosen when the engine starts and runs entirely on the skills' fixtures (TSLA, Oct 19 2026), so you can try everything offline. It can't be changed here.

delay.title: Market data delay
delay.explain: Levelset uses free market data, which can be delayed, incomplete or wrong. Check prices on your trading platform before you act.
delay.sources: Sources: Yahoo Finance (quotes and bars), SEC EDGAR (filings), Nasdaq Trader (symbol lists).
delay.pro: Real-time data is planned as a future Pro feature.

ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.description: Plain-language summaries with your own Claude API key. Off by default; every tool works without it.
ai.enableHint: Off by default. Nothing is sent to an AI service while this is off.

what.earnings: Plain-language summaries of earnings reports and calls.
what.news: A short "why is it moving" note from the day's headlines.

ai.notNeeded: Every tool works without AI: the scanner, plans, the Time Machine, risk checks and tickets don't use it.
ai.cost: It uses your own Claude API key, so any usage is billed to your Anthropic account.

key.title: Claude API key
key.subtitle: Stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in plain files. Levelset can't show it again.
key.hint: Create a key in the Anthropic Console. It starts with sk-ant-.
key.savedHint: The key is stored securely on this computer. To change it, remove it and save a new one.
key.saveFailed: Couldn't save the key in Windows Credential Manager
key.desktopOnly: API keys can only be saved in the Levelset desktop app, where they go to Windows Credential Manager. The browser demo never stores keys.

errors.format: That doesn't look like a Claude API key (sk-ant-…)

appearance.presetsHint: Seven built-in presets, including a light theme. Select one to apply it.
appearance.presetHint: Built-in themes are read-only. Changing a colour creates your own copy.
appearance.customHint: Your theme. Changes apply instantly and are saved on this computer.
appearance.previewHint: Ticket levels always use the Text colour. Profit and Loss only colour the small markers.
appearance.resetDone: Colours reset to the original preset
appearance.name: Name
appearance.nameHint: Give your theme a short name.
appearance.deleteHint: This theme will be removed from this computer. Export it first if you want to keep a copy.

contrast.title: Contrast check (WCAG AA)
contrast.ok: All colour pairs meet WCAG AA contrast.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The whole interface switches instantly.
language.formatsHint: Numbers and dates follow the language you choose.
language.marketTimeNote: Market times are always shown in New York time (ET), wherever you are.

about.title: About Levelset
about.notAdvice: Not financial advice. Most day traders lose money.
about.thirdPartyHint: Levelset runs the day-trader-skill pack, used under the MIT License.

fills.title: Today's fills
fills.subtitle: Fills you recorded by hand today (New York date). Delete one if it was entered by mistake; positions, P/L and the daily risk count update.
fills.emptyHint: Record a fill from a ticket after you place the order on your platform.
fills.confirmBody: {{side}} {{qty}} {{symbol}} at {{price}} will be removed. Your positions, today's P/L and the daily risk count are recalculated. This can't be undone.
